p.i: significat αὐτὸν, αὐτὴν, αὐτὸ, ἀὑτοῖς, αὐ-

main_text.p: Decem possessiva sunt á genitivis trium primitivorum. tria prima á primo:
A singulari, ἐμὸς, ἐμὴ, ἐμὸν, meus, mea, meum.
A duali, νωΐτερος, νωΐτερα, νωΐτερον, noster, nostra, nostrum duorum.
A plurali, ἡμέτερος, ἡμετέρα, ἡμέτερον, noster, nostra, nostrum plurium.
A singulari, σὸς, σὴ, σὸν, tuus, tua, tuum.

p.i: Dorice τεὸς τεὰ τεὸν, τεῶ τεᾶς τεῶ: vertendo σ in τ. Æoles articulum conjungunt, & pro ὁ σὸς, ἡ σὴ, τὸ σὸν, dicunt ὄσος, ἥση, τόσον.

page.notes: Page is faded and stained; Greek accents and some letters in the first lines (e.g. "σφέας", "ἡ") are doubtful. Words near the stains ("ἐμὸς", "ἡμέτερος") may contain printing errors. The bottom of the page is blank apart from stains.
